posts.title: Read the colors, too.
posts.instagram_caption:
A word does more than deal damage in War of Words. The colors of its tiles charge matching ability slots. Words of six or more tiles double that energy gain. So your next word can help prepare your next ability, too. Would you build an attack or charge a shield? Current development rules; balance may change.

#WarOfWords #GameStrategy #WordGame #IndieGame
